name: DSSP
summary: Assign protein secondary structure from supplied atomic coordinates.
notes: DSSP 4 assigns secondary structure to an existing 3D model; it does not predict structure from sequence. The conda artifact is comparatively large (roughly 96 MB on Windows and 204 MB on Linux/macOS before dependencies), so review disk and bandwidth availability. Recent DSSP writes annotated mmCIF by default; specify an output format when downstream tools require legacy DSSP text.
